attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"It is a shame the only thing being traded currently is gossip about a piece of rock.","severity":"minor","reason":"states as fact an ongoing activity at the fair that the briefing does not report"},{"span":"The Lantern Accord is hosting a trade fair at Lantern Hill, as I reported last time.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a second item, though marked as old; padded beyond the one new thing"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin should have been one item of 40 to 80 words, but it pads with a second item that repeats the trade fair, and it claims gossip is the only thing traded.
